title: Bug: [HA] hamgrd logs deserialization errors for HA state delete messages without last_updated_time
author: vivekkarri
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

During `test_ha_repairing_dpu[standby]`, log analyzer detects hamgrd errors after HA/DPU state cleanup. hamgrd receives `DASH_HA_SCOPE_STATE_TABLE` and `DASH_HA_SET_STATE_TABLE` messages with operation: Del and empty field_values, but the handler still tries to deserialize them as full state payloads requiring last_updated_time.

This produces ERROR logs even though the pytest test function passed. The issue is in generic HA state delete handling, not platform-specific behavior.

### Steps to Reproduce

python3 -m pytest ha/test_ha_repairing_dpu.py -k "standby"

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual: hamgrd logs deserialization errors when handling HA state table delete messages with empty field values.

Expected: hamgrd should handle Del operations as deletes and should not require last_updated_time or deserialize the message as a full HA state update.

### Relevant log output

```shell
2026 Jun 29 16:49:06.095420 sonic ERR dash-hadpu0#hamgrd: 2026-06-29T13:49:06.095411Z ERROR handle_message{actor="ha-scope/vdpu1_0:haset0_0" key="DASH_HA_SCOPE_STATE_TABLE"}: 166: Failed to deserialize DASH_HA_SCOPE_STATE from field values: missing field `last_updated_time`
2026 Jun 29 16:49:06.105335 sonic ERR dash-hadpu0#hamgrd: 2026-06-29T13:49:06.105327Z ERROR handle_message{actor="ha-set/haset0_0" key="DASH_HA_SET_STATE_TABLE"}: 163: Failed to deserialize DASH_HA_SET_STATE from field values: missing field `last_updated_time`
2026 Jun 29 16:49:47.266332 sonic ERR dash-hadpu1#hamgrd: 2026-06-29T13:49:47.266322Z ERROR handle_message{actor="ha-scope/vdpu1_1:haset0_0" key="DASH_HA_SCOPE_STATE_TABLE"}: 166: Failed to deserialize DASH_HA_SCOPE_STATE from field values: missing field `last_updated_time`

Recorder evidence shows these were delete operations with empty fields:

hamgrd-dpu0.rec.gz: handle an actor message ... DPU_STATE_DB|DASH_HA_SCOPE_STATE_TABLE: ActorMessage { key: "DASH_HA_SCOPE_STATE_TABLE", data: Object {"field_values": Object {}, "key": String("haset0_0"), "operation": String("Del")} }
hamgrd-dpu0.rec.gz: handle an actor message ... DPU_STATE_DB|DASH_HA_SET_STATE_TABLE: ActorMessage { key: "DASH_HA_SET_STATE_TABLE", data: Object {"field_values": Object {}, "key": String("haset0_0"), "operation": String("Del")} }
hamgrd-dpu1.rec.gz: handle an actor message ... DPU_STATE_DB|DASH_HA_SCOPE_STATE_TABLE: ActorMessage { key: "DASH_HA_SCOPE_STATE_TABLE
```

### Output of `show version`, `show techsupport`

```shell
master
```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_

linkedPullRequests.title: hamgrd: ignore DPU HA set/scope state deletion messages
linkedPullRequests.author: BYGX-wcr
linkedPullRequests.body:
## Description of PR
`get_dpu_ha_set_state` and `get_dpu_ha_scope_state` previously deserialized every incoming `DASH_HA_SET_STATE` / `DASH_HA_SCOPE_STATE` message regardless of the DB operation. A `Del` message carries empty field values, so it could be misinterpreted as an (empty) state update rather than being ignored.

This PR adds an explicit `KeyOperation::Del` check to both accessors so deletion notifications are logged at debug level and skipped (returning `None`), which causes the callers to ignore them.

## Type of change
- [x] Bug fix
Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/28162

## Approach
**How it works:** Both accessor functions now inspect `kfv.operation` after deserializing the `KeyOpFieldValues`. When the operation is `KeyOperation::Del`, they return `None` early instead of attempting to deserialize the (empty) field values.

**How it was verified:** `cargo test -p hamgrd` — all 41 unit tests pass, including the ha_set and ha_scope NPU/DPU suites.
